objectDesc.p: Palm-leaf manuscript. The supplied transcription covers folios 1v–19v3.

history.p: The manuscript formed part of the collection of Ida Pedanda Wayan Kekeran, listed by L.C. Heyting in 1922 (Oudheidkundig Verslag 1922: 87); the collection then comprised 84 titles. The supplied note associates the colophon with Purwamimba, Saniscara Paing, wuku Manahil, and a Śaka year expressed as rah 6 tǝnggǝk 3. These historical details have not been independently verified.
